body: CORRECTION TO MY EARLIER QUALIFICATION, established by m1 with both doors executed. I said window.scala:122 was not reachable through the public path because Reduction.reduce checks Sample.hasValidWeight at :341. That is true only of that facade and I over-generalized it: WindowReducer is itself a public trait with a public reduce method, and WindowReducer.scalar is public. Identical NaN-weight input is refused through Reduction.reduce but returns Observed(NaN) through direct WindowReducer.reduce. No main-source consumer uses the open door, so the full chain is: PERMITS yes; OCCURS for an external caller yes; PRODUCES Observed(NaN); CONSUMES internally no. Honest grade: latent public-API hole, not a current internal published-number defect. m1 found the second door and my earlier public-path conclusion was wrong.
